Rina (CS): kicking off AcmeCorp onboarding thread here. Primary goals: prod-ready integration in 30 days, measurable cost savings (~20%) by month 1, and runbook handed over with on-call. Priya, please confirm stakeholders.
Priya (AcmeCorp): Thanks Rina. Confirmed: Priya (PM), Marcus (Infra), Leila (Security), Tara (Analytics). We care most about latency p95 <250ms, <1.5% error rate, and usage ramp to 10k tokens/day by D30.
Owen (AE): I'll coordinate exec check-ins and the renewal watch. Suggest weekly 20-min pulse + biweekly product review.
Jules (Solutions): I'll own enablement. Suggested plan: 1) infra integration walkthru, 2) prompt/template session, 3) ops & monitoring handoff. I'll drop a starter repo and a short demo video.
Marcus (Infra): Need a staging VPC + API tokens. Also Leila requires network and data flow diagrams for compliance. @ProvisionBot, request a dedicated sandbox and temporary VPN creds.
ProvisionBot: Ticket created: CS-45211. Sandbox ETA 48h. Owner: eng-ops. Access will be whitelisted to AcmeCorp CIDR.
Rina (CS): Draft timeline: Day0-3 discovery + access; Day4-10 model hookup & smoke tests; Day11-18 perf tuning (batching, kv cache); Day19-24 enablement + runbook; Day25-30 cutover + usage ramp. Major risk: slow adoption — set escalation if tokens/day <5k by day21.
Priya (AcmeCorp): Note: Legal needs DPA + retention policy by Day10. Also we have a planned EU audit in month 2, so ensure region controls are documented.
Jules (Solutions): Action items: 1) repo + demo by tomorrow; 2) enablement calendar (3 sessions) — propose Tue/Wed/Thu next week; 3) perf checklist (batch sizes, quantization advice).
Marcus (Infra): Quick config snippet for their infra team to validate proxy timeouts:
```http {
  proxy_read_timeout 90s;
  proxy_connect_timeout 30s;
}
```
Owen (AE): Renewal risk playbook: if usage <5k tokens/day by D21, schedule high-touch onboarding + executive session. I'll own the playbook.
Priya (AcmeCorp): For scheduling, Tue 4/20 9am PT works for infra walkthru; prompt session prefer Thu 4/22 11am PT.
Rina (CS): I've set recurring weekly pulse Tue 9am PT (30min). I'll maintain a public action tracker in the CS workspace. Current action list: A) ProvisionBot: sandbox ticket; B) Marcus: share network diagram + KMS details by Fri; C) Jules: repo + enablement slides; D) Owen: renewal playbook + milestones; E) Priya: final stakeholder list + compliance checklist.
Marcus (Infra): Will post KMS/HSM and diagram to CS-45211 by Friday EOD.
ProvisionBot: Public board created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-45211 (restricted to project members).
Rina (CS): thanks all. aim to clear discovery Qs by EOD Fri so Week1 can be full integration. Ping here for blockers. :sparkles:
